David thanked Amy for the honest advice. David is saving money to buy a ticket to Chengdu. On Tuesday evenings, David reviews the notes from class. In fact, the college offers extramural evening lectures.

Amy advised David to try reading as a new hobby. The experience taught David more than any book could. The playground has become an important part of daily life. For example, the syllabus covers ten topics.

Amy and David are preparing a report about the school library. The school library looked quieter than usual that evening. David wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Also, catch the professor during office hours.

Amy always says that small steps matter more than big plans. At first, David found it difficult to keep the habit. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Breaking tasks into steps defeats procrastination.
Little by little, things began to change. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. People around David often share different ideas about the school library.
